resources.string: With Audio set to Both, local recordings get two audio tracks: track 1 is game, track 2 is microphone. Import both into your video editor; many players play only the first track. Live streams and their archives stay mixed. Adds one audio encoder. Game voice chat is not affected.
Optional two-track local MP4 recordings for editing, with individual AAC bitrates. Off by default. Uses one extra audio encoder; video capture is unchanged.
Mixed audio, Track 1 · Game and Track 2 · Microphone now have their own bitrates. Your previous game bitrate is kept. Clearer concurrent microphone setup texts.
An audio encoder error no longer deletes a two-track recording, and two-track recordings keep more room for audio at the start.
Optional accessibility assistance for game voice chat. No screen access or overlays. Verified on Android 12 / MIUI 14; other devices may still be silenced by Android.
Lets REC share the microphone while a game uses voice chat. Also turn on its entry in Accessibility settings. Verified on Android 12 / MIUI 14 only.

Lets REC request shared microphone input while a game uses voice chat, so your voice can be recorded. It does not read screen content, perform touches or show overlays. Android and the game may still block capture. Verified on Android 12 / MIUI 14 only; other devices may behave differently.
Assistance on. Sharing still depends on Android and the game.
Assistance off. In Accessibility settings, turn on “%1$s”. Until then, Android\'s normal microphone rules apply.
Android has silenced REC\'s microphone. Your voice is not being recorded right now.
Active status and controls for zero-copy screen recording
Quick recording and overlay controls in notification shade
REC requires overlay permission to show the floating game pill controls.
